info.title: LBreakoutU
info.author: thedharex
info.description: It's a port of LBreakoutHD for the Wii U
info.details: LBreakoutU is an HD remake of the classic LBreakout2 breakout-style game. This version is a direct port to the Nintendo Wii U using the WUT (Wii U Toolchain) framework.\n\nIt includes native support for the Wii U GamePad, featuring full button controls, analog/D-Pad navigation, and touch screen support—which is especially useful for both gameplay and the integrated Level Editor! Custom levels are fully supported and are saved directly to your SD card.
